Data Analyst.title: Junior / Associate Data Analyst
Data Analyst.description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented Data Analyst to interpret complex datasets and deliver actionable business insights.

Key Responsibilities:
- Query relational databases using SQL to extract and transform large datasets.
- Perform statistical analysis and exploratory data analysis using Python, Pandas, and NumPy.
- Design and publish interactive dashboards and KPI reports using Power BI, Tableau, and Excel.
- Work collaboratively with cross-functional product teams to define metrics and automate routine reporting.

Required Qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field.
- Strong proficiency in SQL and Python (Pandas, Matplotlib, Seaborn).
- Hands-on experience building business dashboards in Power BI or Tableau.
- Solid understanding of core statistical concepts and data cleaning methodologies.
- Experience with Git version control is preferred.

Data Scientist.title: Data Scientist
Data Scientist.description:
Join our AI research team as a Data Scientist building predictive models and statistical algorithms for enterprise analytics.

Key Responsibilities:
- Formulate data science problems and translate business challenges into machine learning solutions.
- Perform feature engineering, exploratory data analysis, and data preprocessing on structured and unstructured datasets.
- Train, evaluate, and fine-tune machine learning models using Scikit-learn, XGBoost, and Python.
- Write SQL queries to extract data from PostgreSQL and data lakes.
- Collaborate with ML engineers to deploy models into production environments via Docker.

Required Skills:
- Proficiency in Python, NumPy, Pandas, and Scikit-learn.
- Solid mathematical grounding in Statistics, Probability, and Machine Learning algorithms.
- Hands-on experience with SQL databases and Git.
- Familiarity with Deep Learning frameworks (TensorFlow or PyTorch) is a strong plus.

Python Developer.title: Backend Python Developer
Python Developer.description:
We are looking for a skilled Python Backend Developer to design, build, and maintain high-performance RESTful APIs and distributed microservices.

Responsibilities:
- Develop asynchronous REST APIs using FastAPI or Django/Flask.
- Design and optimize relational database schemas using PostgreSQL, SQLAlchemy, and Redis caching.
- Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code with Pytest and unit testing best practices.
- Containerize applications using Docker and participate in CI/CD pipeline automation.
- Collaborate using Git and GitHub in an Agile sprint environment.

Requirements:
- 1+ years experience developing backend applications in Python.
- Strong expertise in FastAPI, Flask, or Django.
- Strong database knowledge including SQL, PostgreSQL, and ORM tools.
- Familiarity with Docker, Linux environment, Git, and REST API design.

Machine Learning Engineer.title: Machine Learning Engineer
Machine Learning Engineer.description:
Cortex Intelligence is hiring a Machine Learning Engineer to bridge the gap between machine learning models and robust production systems.

Responsibilities:
- Design, train, evaluate, and operationalize deep learning and machine learning models.
- Implement Natural Language Processing (NLP) or Computer Vision pipelines using PyTorch or TensorFlow.
- Deploy models as scalable microservices using FastAPI, Docker, and Kubernetes.
- Implement MLOps best practices, monitoring model drift, and automating retraining workflows.

Qualifications:
- Strong programming fundamentals in Python and object-oriented architecture.
- Demonstrated experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow and Scikit-learn.
- Experience deploying models with Docker and container workflows.
- Good knowledge of Git, Linux, and REST APIs.

Software Developer.title: Software Development Engineer (SDE)
Software Developer.description:
We are seeking a versatile Software Developer with strong foundation in computer science and algorithmic problem-solving.

Responsibilities:
- Develop, test, and maintain client-server software components.
- Write efficient, testable, and robust code in Python, Java, or C++.
- Implement data structures and algorithms to solve complex data processing problems.
- Participate in code reviews, system design discussions, and Agile sprints.

Requirements:
- Strong foundation in Data Structures, Algorithms, and Object-Oriented Programming.
- Proficiency in at least one modern language: Python, Java, or C++.
- Experience with SQL databases and Git version control.
- Understanding of REST APIs and software development life cycle (SDLC).
